checklist_items.title: React Fundamentals — JSX, Components, Props
checklist_items.description: JSX syntax, functional components, props passing, children, prop types, default props, key prop
checklist_items.market_relevance: React là library frontend phổ biến nhất thế giới

checklist_items.title: State và Event Handling
checklist_items.description: useState hook, setState batching, event handlers (onClick, onChange), controlled components, uncontrolled refs
checklist_items.market_relevance: State management là core của React applications

checklist_items.title: Effects và Data Fetching
checklist_items.description: useEffect, dependencies array, cleanup functions, abort controllers, race conditions, data fetching patterns
checklist_items.market_relevance: useEffect là hook quan trọng nhất sau useState

checklist_items.title: Conditional Rendering và Lists
checklist_items.description: Ternary, &&, .map() với key, fragments, dynamic CSS classes, rendering nothing with null
checklist_items.market_relevance: Conditional rendering và list rendering dùng hằng ngày

checklist_items.title: Forms và Controlled Inputs
checklist_items.description: Controlled vs uncontrolled, form submission, form validation, React Hook Form, handleChange patterns
checklist_items.market_relevance: Forms là requirement cho 90% của web applications

checklist_items.title: Component Composition và Patterns
checklist_items.description: Lifting state up, composition vs inheritance, render props, higher-order components, children pattern
checklist_items.market_relevance: Composition patterns là key skill cho senior React developers

checklist_items.title: Advanced Hooks
checklist_items.description: useRef, useCallback, useMemo, useContext, useReducer, useId, custom hooks, when to optimize
checklist_items.market_relevance: Advanced hooks phân biệt junior và senior React developers

checklist_items.title: Context API và Global State
checklist_items.description: createContext, Provider, useContext, context composition, performance considerations, when to use Context vs external state
checklist_items.market_relevance: Context API cho phép global state không cần third-party library

checklist_items.title: Performance Optimization
checklist_items.description: React.memo, useMemo, useCallback, key prop, avoid unnecessary renders, React DevTools Profiler, code splitting
checklist_items.market_relevance: Performance optimization là interview topic phổ biến

checklist_items.title: React Router v6
checklist_items.description: Routes, Route, Link, NavLink, useNavigate, useParams, useLocation, nested routes, protected routes, outlet
checklist_items.market_relevance: React Router là bắt buộc cho multi-page React apps

checklist_items.title: State Management với Zustand / Redux Toolkit
checklist_items.description: Zustand stores (simple), Redux Toolkit (createSlice, createAsyncThunk, RTK Query), when to use which
checklist_items.market_relevance: State management là kritical skill cho large React apps

checklist_items.title: Data Fetching với TanStack Query
checklist_items.description: useQuery, useMutation, query keys, cache management, stale time, optimistic updates, prefetching

checklist_items.title: TypeScript với React
checklist_items.description: FC<Props>, useState<T>, event types, generic components, useRef typing, forwardRef, as const assertions

checklist_items.market_relevance: Testing là bắt buộc cho production React apps

checklist_items.title: React 19 — New Features
checklist_items.description: use() hook, Actions (form action), useFormStatus, useOptimistic, Server Components basics, ref as prop, compiler
checklist_items.market_relevance: React 19 features là trending interview topics

checklist_items.title: Error Boundaries và Suspense
checklist_items.description: ErrorBoundary class component, Suspense, lazy(), code splitting, streaming, React 19 async patterns
checklist_items.market_relevance: Error boundaries và Suspense là production requirements

checklist_items.title: Accessibility (a11y)
checklist_items.description: Semantic HTML, aria attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, screen readers, react-aria library
checklist_items.market_relevance: Accessibility là legal requirement trong nhiều countries

checklist_items.title: Production Build và Deployment
checklist_items.description: Vite production build, bundle analysis, environment variables, Docker deployment, CDN optimization, Core Web Vitals
checklist_items.market_relevance: Production deployment skills thiết yếu cho senior developer
